# terminal-stars

> Educational 3D starfield visualizer for the terminal

## What This Is

A ~1,500 line C program demonstrating terminal graphics programming concepts:
- 3D perspective projection (divide by Z for depth)
- Camera transformations (Euler angles: yaw, pitch, roll)
- Double-buffered rendering (flicker-free animation)
- Delta-time animation (frame-rate independent)
- Six visual effects (linear, spiral, warp, tunnel, explode, wave)

## What This Is NOT

This is NOT the full terminal shader/combat simulator. For that, see:
https://github.com/jcaldwell-labs/atari-style

## Key Files

- src/render.c - 3D projection math, camera transforms
- src/effects.c - Six animation techniques
- src/main.c - CLI parsing, main loop, input handling
- include/types.h - Core data structures (Star, Camera, Starfield, FrameBuffer)

## Build & Run

```bash
# Requirements: GCC, ncurses
sudo apt install libncurses-dev

# Build and run
make && ./terminal-stars

# With options
./terminal-stars --stars 1000 --speed 2.0 --effect spiral --zoom 75
```

## CLI Options

--stars N     Number of stars (10-5000, default: 500)
--speed F     Speed multiplier (0.1-5.0, default: 1.0)
--effect E    Effect: linear|spiral|warp|tunnel|explode|wave (default: linear)
--zoom F      Zoom level (10-200, default: 50.0)
--help        Show help

## Keyboard Controls

Tab     Cycle effects
1-6     Select effect directly
+/-     Adjust speed
[/]     Adjust zoom
Q/ESC   Quit

## Learning Path

1. types.h - Understand Star, Camera, Starfield, FrameBuffer structs
2. terminal.c - ncurses initialization pattern
3. render.c - The perspective projection formula
4. effects.c - Six different animation techniques
5. main.c - Game loop: input → update → render → display
